reason: The method compresses and debiases vision-language pretrained models for visual-question-answering and evaluates VQA accuracy/bias under compression. This is a transformer/VLM compression method, but the experiments are vision-language-specific and do not establish LLM generation-serving performance; linked low-bit transformer lineage is indirect.
title: Compressing And Debiasing Vision-Language Pre-Trained Models for Visual Question Answering
